transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I'm just... tired, I guess. It doesn't really make a lot of sense to me. I mean, I sleep fine. I'm still keeping up with things at work. But... I just feel like I'm running on a low battery, you know? Like, before the day even really gets going.
Have you noticed that you’re not enjoying things as much as you used to, even things you normally like doing?

I suppose... yeah. It's just been this... flat, kind of gray feeling for a long time now. Most days, anyway. 

Things I usually look forward to, like... going fishing, or tending the tomatoes out back. Even just a church concert. I don't know. They just feel like items on a checklist now, rather than... something I actually enjoy doing.
Do you find yourself feeling down or low most of the time, even when there’s no clear reason for it?
I guess so. Yeah, I suppose I do. Just... low. Most days. There's not really a reason for it, it's just... there.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently, or do you feel more restless or slowed down than usual?

I haven't really thought about being restless. But... I guess my appetite has been off lately. More days than not, anyway. 

I'll be at my desk and just... work right through lunch without really noticing. And then I mostly just pick at my dinner. My wife actually made a comment the other day that my pants are looking looser. I'm not trying to lose weight or anything, I just... don't have much interest in eating right now, I suppose.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty or like you’re not good enough for no clear reason lately?
No... I don't think so. I don't really have anything to feel guilty about. And I wouldn't say I feel like I'm not good enough, either. It's not really like that. Just... what I mentioned before.
Have you noticed that you feel fatigued or have a lack of energy most days, even when you haven't done much physically or mentally?

Yeah... I suppose so. That's mostly why I came in, actually. I'm just tired in a way that doesn't really make sense. I mean, I can sleep fine, and I keep up with things at work alright. But... I still just feel like I'm running on a low battery. Even before the day really gets going.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating or thinking clearly lately, even when you're not particularly tired?
No... not really. I can still focus on things just fine. Work hasn't been an issue or anything. It's just... what I said before, about the energy.
Would you say that you’ve completely stopped taking part in activities you used to enjoy, or are you still doing them but just not getting the same pleasure out of them?

Well... I still do them. I haven't stopped. It's just... for a long time now, there's been this sort of gray, flat feeling most days. Even with things I used to look forward to. Going fishing, tending to the tomatoes in the yard, going to a church concert... they just feel like items on a checklist now. I do them, but... I don't really get much out of it anymore.
How long have you been feeling this way — with the low energy, the flat mood, and not getting pleasure out of things?
It's been a while. Um... probably about two years and four months, I'd say. That's... well, that's when they pulled me back into full operational leadership at work. So, since around then.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, feeling more restless or fidgety lately?
No... I haven't noticed anything like that. I'm not restless or... moving slow. Just normal, I suppose.

Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt down or low most of the time, lasting for at least two weeks, where you noticed a big difference in how you were feeling compared to your usual self?
No... I don't think so. Not like that. Just... just the way I've been feeling lately, like I mentioned. Nothing... nothing that stands out as a separate time.
